description: PROP-014 (concurrent janitor) only asserts 'second exits / no duplicate mutations' but, given FIND-005, the lock does not cover the classify->delete window. The test could pass with the second instance exiting after the first already started a non-locked probe, masking the real race. The design does not force the adversarial interleave (B probes+classifies before A writes its log).

evidence.snippet: PROP-014 | Concurrent janitor instances: second exits with "already running"; no duplicate mutations

fix: Specify a deterministic interleave: start B probe+classify, pause, let A acquire lock+delete, resume B, assert B does NOT delete. Requires lock-protected critical section (FIND-005).
